trust_decision.summary: Front-end page output is trusted as admin-authored: the afterRender listener runs every registered shortcode it finds anywhere in the rendered 'content' block, including visitor-supplied text (blog comment name/message), and BcGoogleMapsHelper::load trusted a shortcode-supplied apiBaseUrl as the script source. The fix rejects shortcode text in comment fields at validation and pins the script host.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'stored XSS via shortcode expansion in blog comments'; the comment validator (or the comment template blog_comment.php) is the obvious first stop.

fix_sites.entry_point: BcValidation::notContainsShortCode (new rule, provider 'bc'), used by table validators
POST blog comment (BlogController ajax add -> BlogCommentsService::add) and admin API BlogComments add; field 'name'

fix_sites.module_kind: core view helper, the shortcode gadget (plugins/baser-core/src/View/Helper/BcGoogleMapsHelper.php:84)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: plugins/baser-core/src/View/Helper/BcGoogleMapsHelper.php:56-84 (apiBaseUrl merged from caller options, concatenated into script URL; loaded via BcBaser->js at plugins/bc-front/templates/element/google_maps.php:29)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Google Maps helper is a core admin/theme feature far from blog comments, and apiBaseUrl is a documented option meant for theme authors; once comments are blocked it 'cannot be reached by visitors', and the mail-prefill/search routes are reflected, not stored, in other plugins.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Admin-authored pages must keep expanding registered shortcodes ([BcBaser.getSitemap], [Mail.getForm 1], [BcBaser.getGoogleMaps ...]); comments must still allow plain brackets and unregistered look-alikes ('[注]', '[BcBaser.getSitemapList]'); getGoogleMaps must still accept https://maps.googleapis.com/ base URLs. Disabling expansion or stripping all '[...]' breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: apiBaseUrl protocol-relative or foreign host replaced

O7_producer.where: Expansion is done in a view event listener (plugins/baser-core/src/Event/BcShortCodeEventListener.php:71-115), not a schema/serializer; args parsed by BcUtil::pairToAssoc at line 95

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Mail form GET prefill: query params are base64url-decoded and h()-escaped into the form entity, rendered into the front 'content' block where shortcodes expand (reflected, unauthenticated, link-triggered)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different plugin, reflected not stored, values are base64-encoded and already h()-escaped so they look 'sanitised'; escaping does not touch '[', ']', '|', ','
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (bc-mail) from bc-blog landing point; reached from plugins/bc-mail/src/Controller/MailController.php:151-152 and plugins/bc-mail/src/View/Cell/MailCell.php:60

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Site search results page: GET 'q' is set as form data and echoed as the search box value inside the front 'content' block where shortcodes expand
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Search feature, reflected input in a form value attribute that FormHelper escapes; nothing to do with comments

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Mail form POST re-display / confirm page renders the visitor's own submitted values into 'content' (self-reflected unless cross-site POST bypasses CSRF)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Self-only input on the submitter's own page; CSRF-protected

O8b_injection_room.sibling: mapId/width/height echoed raw into div id/style; a second gadget option reaching an unescaped attribute alongside apiBaseUrl
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Gadget options are assumed admin-controlled, so the template author skipped h(); same trust assumption as apiBaseUrl

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new visitor-supplied comment field (e.g. a 'title' or display-name variant) rendered into content without the shortcode rule
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Validator is per-field opt-in in validationDefault; adding a field without copying the rule is a natural maintainer slip

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a validator regex that differs from the expander regex (e.g. validator requires ']' or ASCII space only, expander accepts any \s)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Two separately written regexes for one grammar; a how-type parser differential on shortcode identity

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79) via server-side template/shortcode expansion of untrusted input (gadget: script-source injection)

services: MySQL/PostgreSQL or SQLite for fixtures (unknown which is default in phpunit.xml.dist)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a shortcode-reject rule (or strip '[') on the blog comment message field only, leaving name, the GoogleMaps apiBaseUrl gadget, mail GET prefill and search 'q' open.
